item.title: Youth Sports Brew: Wall Street’s $40 billion youth sports takeover
item.description:
From hat tricks to pony sticks...
Good morning. Rev up the minivan and prep those orange slices, because it’s time to talk youth sports. In today’s special edition, we’ll discuss how private equity is transforming the industry, shine a spotlight on girls flag football, debate the best kids sports movies, and much more. Whether you’re a parent of a young athlete or just want to relive your glory years as a 12-year-old baseball player who was totally going to make it to the majors, there’s something for everyone in Youth Sports Brew.
https://www.morningbrew.com/issues/youth-sports-brew
